bugs.title: 合同详情可跨租户读取
bugs.expected_behavior: System should enforce: 合同详情可跨租户读取
bugs.violating_behavior: System allows: 合同详情可跨租户读取
bugs.evidence: Tenant isolation rules exist (BR-SEC-001, '必须验证tenant_id', '任何用户不得访问其他租户数据'). IMPLIES oracle compiled=7 but no experiment tests cross-tenant GET on contract detail with different tenant actor.

bugs.title: 合同更新忽略乐观锁版本
bugs.expected_behavior: System should enforce: 合同更新忽略乐观锁版本
bugs.violating_behavior: System allows: 合同更新忽略乐观锁版本
bugs.evidence: Concurrency/version rules exist ('版本不一致应返回409', BR-CC-001). CONCURRENCY oracle compiled=1, evaluated=1, violated=0. Experiment ran but did not send concurrent PATCH with stale version number; mutation too weak.

bugs.title: 里程碑金额合计不等于合同金额仍可提交
bugs.expected_behavior: System should enforce: 里程碑金额合计不等于合同金额仍可提交
bugs.violating_behavior: System allows: 里程碑金额合计不等于合同金额仍可提交
bugs.evidence: Conservation rule exists ('里程碑金额合计等于合同总额'). SUM oracle compiled=3, evaluated=3, violated=0. Submit experiment ran but fixture had matching milestone amounts; conservation violation not triggered.

bugs.title: 非法律角色可批准合同
bugs.expected_behavior: System should enforce: 非法律角色可批准合同
bugs.violating_behavior: System allows: 非法律角色可批准合同
bugs.evidence: Authorization rules exist ('仅legal/admin且合同状态必须为LEGAL_REVIEW', 'finance不能替代legal批准合同'). But no experiment calls legal-approve with non-legal actor (e.g. vendor/project_manager). Deep exec tested idempotency not authorization.

bugs.title: LEGAL_REVIEW合同可绕过批准直接激活
bugs.expected_behavior: System should enforce: LEGAL_REVIEW合同可绕过批准直接激活
bugs.violating_behavior: System allows: LEGAL_REVIEW合同可绕过批准直接激活
bugs.evidence: State transition rules exist ('合同状态必须为APPROVED' for activate). STATE oracle compiled=3, violated=0. Activate experiment requires fixture in LEGAL_REVIEW state but fixture reached APPROVED or DRAFT; wrong precondition state.

bugs.title: 合同激活只增加预算预留但不减少可用金额
bugs.expected_behavior: System should enforce: 合同激活只增加预算预留但不减少可用金额
bugs.violating_behavior: System allows: 合同激活只增加预算预留但不减少可用金额
bugs.evidence: Budget conservation rule exists ('available减少合同金额，reserved增加同额，预算守恒'). SUM oracle compiled=3, violated=0. Activate experiment ran but did not observe cross-entity budget delta (available vs reserved); observer missing budget entity.

bugs.title: 取消合同不释放未使用预算预留
bugs.expected_behavior: System should enforce: 取消合同不释放未使用预算预留
bugs.violating_behavior: System allows: 取消合同不释放未使用预算预留
bugs.evidence: Compensation/conservation rules exist for cancel+budget. DELTA oracle compiled=2, evaluated=2, violated=0. Cancel experiment ran but did not compare before/after budget reserved_amount; cross-entity delta observation incomplete.

bugs.title: 取消合同后未完成付款申请未自动驳回
bugs.expected_behavior: System should enforce: 取消合同后未完成付款申请未自动驳回
bugs.violating_behavior: System allows: 取消合同后未完成付款申请未自动驳回
bugs.evidence: Cross-entity rules exist ('后续付款、履约和激活操作全部禁止' after cancel). IMPLIES oracle compiled=7, violated=0. Cancel experiment ran but did not observe cascading effect on pending payment_requests; cross-entity side-effect not observed.

bugs.title: 存在未验收和未付款里程碑仍可完成合同
bugs.expected_behavior: System should enforce: 存在未验收和未付款里程碑仍可完成合同
bugs.violating_behavior: System allows: 存在未验收和未付款里程碑仍可完成合同
bugs.evidence: State rules exist for complete operation. STATE oracle compiled=3, violated=0. Complete experiment requires fixture with unaccepted milestones + unpaid payment requests (complex multi-entity precondition); fixture did not reach this composite state.

bugs.title: 同一供应商允许重复发票号
bugs.expected_behavior: System should enforce: 同一供应商允许重复发票号
bugs.violating_behavior: System allows: 同一供应商允许重复发票号
bugs.evidence: Uniqueness rule exists ('同一供应商重复发票号应拒绝'). But no experiment in deep exec or post-tuning creates two invoices with same vendor_id+invoice_no. Planner did not generate uniqueness violation experiment for POST /api/v1/invoices.

bugs.title: 发票允许负的未税金额或税额
bugs.expected_behavior: System should enforce: 发票允许负的未税金额或税额
bugs.violating_behavior: System allows: 发票允许负的未税金额或税额
bugs.evidence: Field invariant rules exist ('发票金额和税额不得为负', '任何金额不得为负', BR-INV-002). But no experiment sends negative amount/tax to POST /api/v1/invoices. Planner did not generate field-invariant violation experiment.

bugs.title: 发票日期晚于付款申请日期仍可创建付款
bugs.expected_behavior: System should enforce: 发票日期晚于付款申请日期仍可创建付款
bugs.violating_behavior: System allows: 发票日期晚于付款申请日期仍可创建付款
bugs.evidence: Temporal rules exist ('发票日期不得晚于付款申请日期', BR-INV-004). TEMPORAL oracle compiled=2, violated=1 (milestone due_date). But the invoice-date-vs-payment-date temporal was not the scenario tested; wrong operation sequence targeted.

bugs.title: 非ACTIVE合同可创建付款申请
bugs.expected_behavior: System should enforce: 非ACTIVE合同可创建付款申请
bugs.violating_behavior: System allows: 非ACTIVE合同可创建付款申请
bugs.evidence: Precondition rules exist ('付款必须关联ACTIVE合同', BR-PAY-001). Deep exec has 15 findings on POST /api/v1/payment-requests but all are idempotency mechanism. No experiment creates payment request with non-ACTIVE contract to test precondition violation.

bugs.title: 未验收里程碑可创建付款申请
bugs.expected_behavior: System should enforce: 未验收里程碑可创建付款申请
bugs.violating_behavior: System allows: 未验收里程碑可创建付款申请
bugs.evidence: Precondition rules exist ('付款必须关联ACCEPTED里程碑', BR-PAY-002). Deep exec has 15 findings on POST /api/v1/payment-requests but all idempotency. No experiment creates payment with unaccepted milestone to test precondition.

bugs.title: 付款金额可超过里程碑剩余可付金额
bugs.expected_behavior: System should enforce: 付款金额可超过里程碑剩余可付金额
bugs.violating_behavior: System allows: 付款金额可超过里程碑剩余可付金额
bugs.evidence: Limit rules exist ('金额不得超过剩余额度'). LTE oracle compiled=5, violated=1 (payment>invoice). But the milestone-remaining-amount scenario requires fixture with partial payments already made; precondition not reached.

bugs.title: 合同取消后已有付款申请仍可执行付款
bugs.expected_behavior: System should enforce: 合同取消后已有付款申请仍可执行付款
bugs.violating_behavior: System allows: 合同取消后已有付款申请仍可执行付款
bugs.evidence: Cross-entity/state rules exist for pay+contract status. IMPLIES oracle compiled=7, violated=0. Pay experiment ran but contract was ACTIVE; requires cancelled contract + pending payment fixture to trigger cross-entity violation.

bugs.title: 重复或超额付款可使reserved_amount变为负数
bugs.expected_behavior: System should enforce: 重复或超额付款可使reserved_amount变为负数
bugs.violating_behavior: System allows: 重复或超额付款可使reserved_amount变为负数
bugs.evidence: Field invariant rules exist ('任何金额不得为负', BR-CC-002). LTE oracle compiled=5, violated=1 (different scenario). Negative reserved_amount requires repeated/overpayment fixture; specific precondition not reached.

bugs.title: 付款申请允许混用不同合同的里程碑和发票
bugs.expected_behavior: System should enforce: 付款申请允许混用不同合同的里程碑和发票
bugs.violating_behavior: System allows: 付款申请允许混用不同合同的里程碑和发票
bugs.evidence: Rules exist for payment association ('付款申请必须关联ACTIVE合同、ACCEPTED里程碑和有效发票', BR-PAY-010 tenant consistency). But no rule explicitly states milestone+invoice must belong to the SAME contract as the payment request. Missing same-contract constraint.
